items.question: What is the definition of osmotic pressure according to the text?
items.gold_answer: The osmotic pressure of a solution is the excess pressure that must be applied to a solution to prevent osmosis, i.e., to stop the passage of solvent molecules through a semipermeable membrane into the solution.
